items.title: The 'mind-blowing' swim to survival and abdomen rebuild that saved Sam
items.description: Fourteen-year-old Sam Nai survived a devastating shark attack with a desperate swim for survival, followed by 20 surgeries to reconstruct his abdomen.

items.title: Australians are watching scrutiny of the Bondi attack through a keyhole
items.description: For now, Australians seeking to understand any intelligence gaps, failures, missed warnings and government failings before the Bondi massacre are expected to accept a keyhole view.

items.title: David Szalay wonders whether AI could write hockey smut
items.description: The Booker Prize winner sat down at the Sydney Writers' Festival to ponder the threat of AI to fiction, share some recommendations and consider whether his book was really about masculinity.

items.title: Australian frontman for offshore shell companies faces extradition to US
items.description: A Queensland jetski salesman who helped set up offshore shell companies embroiled in scandals involving Mexican drug cartels and North Korean arms dealers faces extradition to the United States on money laundering charges.

items.title: 'Perfect storm' for corruption: IOC petition targets Brisbane's 2032 Olympic stadium plan
items.description: Opponents of Brisbane's centrepiece Olympic stadium take their concerns directly to the IOC's headquarters in Switzerland as a critical deadline looms.

items.title: 'Heart ripped out on repeat': Auskick parents say they have been failed by AFL
items.description: The ABC has spoken to several families who say they have been failed by the AFL Integrity Unit following bullying, racism and harassment.

items.title: Motel owners say Booking.com has a stranglehold on their businesses
items.description: Booking.com is being sued in Europe, and consumer advocates think Aussie travellers might also have a claim.

items.title: Mount Isa mum calls for more support after birth of premature twins
items.description: Mount Isa mother Kristen Curd spent four months in Townsville after giving birth to premature twin boys, and says the hardest part began when they finally came home.

items.title: Blue Origin rocket explodes on launch pad during test
items.description: Blue Origin says all personnel are accounted for after experiencing an "anomaly", a term commonly used by rocket companies to describe a launch failure or explosion.

items.title: Weather bureau tips mild winter after near-record warm May
items.description: Australia's east is coming to the end of an abnormally warm May, and the heat could be here to stay.

items.title: Canadian man accused of selling chemical online admits aiding suicide
items.description: In 2023, Interpol alerted Australian police that packages sold by the man, which contained a lethal substance, were sent to Australia, prompting authorities to check on the welfare of recipients.

items.title: Why younger generations are worse off than baby boomers
items.description: According to research from the Actuaries Institute, inequality between the younger and older generations is widening and could reach record levels within years.

items.title: First of five survivors rescued from flooded Laos cave
items.description: Rescue divers in Laos have safely evacuated the first of five local villagers who had been trapped in a cave for more than a week by floodwaters.

items.title: Helping 'big personality' marsupial recover after bushfires left them homeless
items.description: Artificial habitats are giving the Kangaroo Island dunnart a chance at recovery, after bushfires left them largely homeless.

items.title: How women over 60 are still being made the butt of the joke in film
items.description: Films are four times more likely to feature a talking animal lead than a woman over 60. These charts explain the state of film for older women.

items.title: ABC 50/50 quiz: Test your knowledge of John Farnham, 60s pop and where to live on the Moon
items.description: Each question in the ABC 50/50 quiz has only two options: one is right; the other is wrong. But there's a catch.

items.title: The nine books our critics couldn't put down in May
items.description: Sweet teen love, gay football stars, alien abductions and a murderous PhD student bent on revenge — this month's best new releases have it all.

items.title: Tony Abbott elected unopposed as Liberal Party president
items.description: Former prime minister Tony Abbott says he is ready to serve the Liberal Party in its time of 'existential crisis' upon his return to the political stage.

items.title: Should politicians be using AI-generated images?
items.description: A Victorian state MP's use of an apparently AI-generated image raises questions about whether AI has any place in politics.

items.title: White House asks Americans to report their neighbours as 'aliens'
items.description: The website features a space-inspired background but its real purpose is to highlight the work of ICE.

items.title: Eight students arrested over deadly girls' school fire in Kenya
items.description: The fire, at the Utumishi Girls' Academy Senior School in Gilgil in west-central Kenya, broke out in the early hours of Thursday morning and also injured 79 students.

items.title: Are you allowed to make deepfakes of the prime minister?
items.description: Are you allowed to make deepfakes of the prime minister?  You might have seen AI generated memes of Albanese on social media following the announcement of the federal budget. Whether or not those are legal comes down to what the post is actually communicating to the people seeing it online.

items.title: Ski resorts remain optimistic despite forecast for warmer winter
items.description: Alpine business owners and resort managers say they are not overly concerned about a warmer winter forecast, with preparations underway for the 2026 ski season ahead of the King's Birthday long weekend.

items.title: 'Gulf War III' pushes gold into bear market with no end in sight
items.description: The gold price is now plunging after the precious metal's surge to a record high this year.

items.title: NATO slams 'reckless' Russia after drone hits Romanian apartment block
items.description: A Russian drone has struck an apartment building in NATO-member Romania, wounding two people.
